question: The Therigatha is a Buddhist text, part of the ______ is a collection of verses composed by bhikkhunis.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sutta Pitaka.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Therigatha is classified as part of the Khuddaka Nikaya, the collection of short books in the Sutta Pitaka.**
 
• Therigatha is the **"earliest extant text depicting women's spiritual experiences." in ****Theravada Buddhism****.**
 
• The Therigatha is a collection of 73 poems written by Buddhist nuns&a
